image_urls.description: Dark mystical foggy forest. To be used as a full-screen fixed background with a heavy dark overlay (bg-[#06140D]/85) to create the deep forest atmosphere.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/gold text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 against dark green backgrounds. Do not use gold for small body text.
accessibility.reduce_motion: Disable the breathing glow animation if prefers-reduced-motion is true.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set the background of the app to the Unsplash mystical forest image, with a fixed overlay of 'bg-[#06140D]/85' to heavily darken it and tint it deep green.

The central action is the 'Draw Rune' mechanic. Create a glowing, mystical center area on the Home screen. Avoid generic centered layouts everywhere else: use left-aligned, spacious layouts for the history list and text descriptions.

For the Rune itself, use standard text rendering (e.g., using Unicode Rune characters like ᚠ, ᚢ, ᚦ) or simple text. Make the rune character massive (text-7xl+) and color it Gold (#D4AF37) with a drop-shadow for the glowing effect.

The design must feel like a hidden luxury artifact in the woods. Do not use standard Vercel/Tailwind aesthetics. Rely on 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl with high opacity) for surfaces and pure gold for interactive highlights.
Implement the 25 Elder Futhark runes data structure (name, symbol, meaning, upright/reversed) using Unicode characters.
All interactive elements must include the specified data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Import and use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings/runes, and 'Manrope' for body text.
